<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/audits/policies/new"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a new asset audit policy. Audit policies define automated schedules and rules for verifying asset locations, conditions, and compliance. The policy configuration includes the policy type, name, description, target asset groups (by category, location, or specific assets), verification schedules (frequency, timing), alert notification settings, and assigned auditors or teams. Once created, the policy will generate scheduled audit tasks according to its configuration.

**Minimal Required Fields:**
The request must include all fields marked as required in the UpdateAssetAuditPolicyRequest schema. At minimum, this typically includes policy type, name, and schedule configuration.

**Workflow Example:**
1. Get available policy types: [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies/types](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policy-types)
2. Optionally review existing policies or templates for reference: [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies/templates](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policy-global-templates)
3. Construct the policy request with required configuration
4. Create the policy using this endpoint
5. The response includes the newly created policy with its assigned ID

**Response:**
Returns the complete created policy configuration including the newly assigned AssetAuditPolicyId.
